verdict.rationale: Before a run, researchers can pick a higher-effort job variant: JobNames.LITERATURE_HIGH enables 'high reasoning mode.' They can also pass runtime configuration to the agent and choose among task types. During a run, chat sessions offer queue_chat_message to inject a message into a turn already running, which allows mid-run steering. However, effort control appears to be a coarse mode switch, and no explicit depth or scope parameters are documented. missing for 10: granular depth/effort/scope parameters (e.g., paper count, time or compute budget), documented contents of the runtime configuration, mid-run steering explicitly for research tasks (not just chat sessions), independent or hands-on corroboration.
